title: YouTube video from a screen recording
promise: Record your screen, cut it into a tidy video, add subtitles and export a file that uploads quickly.
audience: Tutorial makers and people who explain software for a living

steps.title: Record the screen and your voice
steps.why: OBS Studio records the screen, a window and your microphone at once, with no watermark and no time limit.

steps.title: Cut out the false starts
steps.why: Kdenlive is a proper timeline editor that is free for good, and trimming pauses and mistakes is most of the work on a tutorial.

steps.title: Generate subtitles
steps.why: Whisper can write an SRT file from the video's audio. It runs locally, so expect a command-line setup, and read the result before you publish it.

steps.title: Export a sensible file
steps.why: HandBrake re-encodes to a widely compatible MP4 and often makes a much smaller file, which speeds up the upload.
